messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

message.content: The best time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but generally the shoulder seasons—late spring (April–June) and early fall (September–November)—offer a great balance of pleasant weather, lower crowds, and more reasonable prices. During these months you’ll enjoy warm temperatures (mid‑70s to low‑80s °F), lower humidity, and fewer tourists compared to the peak winter and summer periods.
